name: Tectonic
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: On August 30, 2024, the Tectonic lending protocol on Cronos was exploited through TONIC price manipulation. The attacker inflated TONIC’s price and used it as collateral to borrow assets, triggering ~$120M in borrowing. Cronos halted the chain and rolled back to restore balances, leaving ~$9.2M unrecovered. Tectonic accepted TONIC,a governance token with low liquidity,as collateral at a 20% collateral factor. The protocol failed to guard against TONIC price manipulation, enabling the attacker to artificially drive up TONIC’s price and borrow large sums against the inflated collateral.
